surface.$description: Default working surface: panels, lists, editors. Body text sits here.

raised.$description: Raised panels and filled secondary controls. Light separates with shadow-raised; dark with a lightness step.

recessed.$description: Recessed wells: context bar, letterbox, code and technical content.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, dialogs (with border-default and shadow-overlay).

hover.$description: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost and icon buttons.

selected.$description: Selected row or item; always with border-selected.

control.$description: Filled neutral controls: secondary buttons, filter chips, segmented tracks. One step beyond bg-hover so a control stays visible inside a hovered row. Labels on it use text-primary or text-secondary, never text-muted.

control-hover.$description: Hover on bg-control. Labels on it are text-primary.

plate.$description: Pure white plate in both themes: behind black product lockups on dark grounds, and the knob of switches.

input.$description: Text fields and selects at rest — a step below the surface in dark so fields read as wells, not cards.

shell.$description: Studio shell: sidebar and global navigation, deep navy in both themes so the workspace reads as a lit stage.

text.$description: Labels on bg-shell, shell-hover and shell-selected.

text-muted.$description: Group headings and secondary labels on bg-shell.

hover.$description: Hover fill for shell navigation items.

selected.$description: Current navigation item on bg-shell; paired with shell-indicator.

indicator.$description: 2px current-item indicator and focus ring in the shell.

border.$description: Divider inside the shell and between shell and workspace.

primary.$description: Headings and body on every bg-* surface.

secondary.$description: Metadata and supporting copy on every bg-* surface.

muted.$description: Tertiary labels and timestamps on surface, raised, canvas, hover and selected (≥4.5:1).

disabled.$description: Disabled labels; exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3). Pair with a reason nearby.

on-action.$description: Label on action-primary, its hover and pressed fills.

link.$description: Links and source references on any bg-* surface.

subtle.$description: Row dividers and section separators. Decorative only.

default.$description: Panel, card, menu and dialog outlines.

strong.$description: Control boundaries (inputs, outline buttons, checkboxes); ≥3:1 on surface, raised and input.

selected.$description: Selected item edge; ≥3:1 on surface and selected.

primary.$description: Primary action fill, active tab indicator, checked controls. One primary action per view.

primary-subtle.$description: Tinted fill for selected toggles and subtle primary emphasis.

destructive.$description: Destructive fill (delete, discard). Pair with text-on-destructive.

ring.$description: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset; ≥3:1 on every surface.

draft-fg.$description: Draft chip label and icon on status-draft-bg.

review-fg.$description: In review chip label and icon on status-review-bg.

approved-fg.$description: Approved chip label and icon on status-approved-bg.

changes-fg.$description: Changes requested chip label and icon on status-changes-bg.

check-fg.$description: Check (currency) and warning text on surface/raised. Outline chip.

check-border.$description: Check outline and warning alert border; ≥3:1 on surface.

outdated-fg.$description: Outdated (currency) text on surface/raised. Outline chip.

outdated-border.$description: Outdated outline and error alert border; ≥3:1 on surface.

error-fg.$description: Validation and error text on surface.

info-fg.$description: Information alert text and icon on surface.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind dialogs and the command menu.
